title: warm, melted moroccan parmesan tagine
description: Cozy roasted dish featuring parmesan, ssam-wrap, and a hint of Moroccan spices. Perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: ssam-wrap (rice paper)
ingredients.notes: large sheets for wrapping the tagine

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: lean beef for a healthier option

instructions: Preheat the kazan (cauldron) to 375°F (190°C) for at least 10 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the beef mixture for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the beef mixture to the preheated kazan and top with grated parmesan cheese.
Place a sheet of ssam-wrap over the top of the kazan to cover it.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tagine from the oven and carefully remove the ssam-wrap to serve.
Serve the warm, melted moroccan parmesan tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
